g.textArea: Turns packs short into pounds of dough per day: only a negative production balance creates dough demand.

rect.data-description: LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =DROP(REDUCE("",Dough[No.],LAMBDA(a,x,VSTACK(a,x,IFERROR(FILTER(Products[No.],(Products[Dough]=x)*(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("OBS",Products[Description]))=FALSE)*(LEFT(Products[No.],1)<>"Z")),"(no products)")))),1). 453 rows: each of the 63 doughs followed by its products.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). ='Daily Supply & Demand'!H2. Display.
FORMULA (this sheet). Formula: =A5 (the row's own A cell).
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Dough Description]),""). The key dough rows are summed on.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Formula: =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Sku],Products[No.],Products[Weight]),""). lb of dough per pack.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Pounds of dough needed that day. Sun: =LET(prod,IF(LEFT([@Sku],2)="F5",XLOOKUP([@Sku],Dist_DSnD[Sku],Dist_DSnD[S_Production],0),XLOOKUP([@Sku],DSD_DSnD[Sku],DSD_DSnD[S_Production],0)),IF(LEFT([@Sku],1)="D",SUMIFS(DoughWeight[Sun],DoughWeight[Dough Desc],[@Desciption]),IF(prod<0,ABS(prod)*[@Weight],0))). F Sun reads S_Production, G Mon M_, H Tue T_, I Wed W_, J Thur TH_, K Fri F_.
NOTE. Mix_Slice Dough Weight (L, for the K4 day) and _Bags for every day, each divided by Dough Weight (lb per bag).
NOTE. Only a negative _Production creates dough. A product with stock left over contributes 0 lb, even if other days are short.
NOTE. F5 codes read Dist_DSnD _Production, which is always minus demand (no stock is netted for cases).
NOTE. D-code rows add up their products by Dough Desc. Mix_Slice sums product rows itself, so dough rows are for reading only.
NOTE. Dough row: Sun 454, Mon 965, Tue 1,176, Wed 402.5, Thu 1,074, Fri 1,220.25 lb. F1127 Challah 3-Braid 21oz, Friday: 36 packs short x 1.3125 lb = 47.25 lb.
NOT USED. VLOOKUP($C4,'Mix-Slice-Oven'!H:H,1,FALSE) on each row. Broken (444 #N/A, drifting references, #REF!). Nothing reads it.
BC EXPORT (pasted). Columns O:AJ hold the pasted BOMQty export. See section 2.
ISSUE. SEARCH("OBS", Description) drops active Lobster rolls (F3310, F53310). Items in the OBS posting group whose description lacks OBS get through.

rect.data-title: Array one row longer than the table
rect.data-description: ISSUE. The spill has 453 rows, the table 452, so the last SKU (F2562) has no formulas. Recon shows Array longer.

rect.data-title: BOM double count flows through here
rect.data-description: ISSUE. Pounds are right, but they are divided by an inflated Dough Weight downstream. See section 1.
ISSUE. F6214 is missing from the external tabs, so its #N/A reaches the D10059 dough row on all six days.
